title: Breaking out of it
summary: Jordan skipped work by calling in sick, mainly to avoid facing Marcus after whatever happened the day before, and spent the morning wallowing before pushing themselves out to Groundwork, where building the visual metronome for their Coda project pulled them out of their funk and left them feeling competent again. Mikayla's brief, low-key coffee visit at noon helped too, just by being present without prying. By afternoon Jordan felt like a different person, closing the day with groceries, stir fry, and a grateful text to Mika, though they noted (again) that they never learn to skip the dark-couch phase before getting moving.
